 This year’s Holiday Meal Basket is bigger, better, and more affordable

 Walmart is making holiday celebrations easier and more affordable with its biggest Holiday Meal Basket yet, featuring more food, greater savings and convenient ways to shop for seasonal favorites. 
 Key Insights 
 Walmart’s 2026 Holiday Meal Basket serves 10 people for $35, just $3.50 per person.
 This year’s basket includes 26 items, offering 18% more food items.
 Available through Dec. 24, the basket offers convenient shopping, pickup and delivery options.
 BENTONVILLE, Ark., Oct. 28, 2026 — Some of Americans’ most memorable holiday moments happen around the table, and this year, Walmart is making it easier and more affordable than ever for families to serve a plentiful and delicious holiday meal. Walmart's highly anticipated Holiday Meal Basket is returning with even more food than last year, available to customers through December 24, 2026 — with the convenience of fast delivery to help families spend less time planning and more time celebrating.
 Walmart’s 2026 Holiday Trend Report showed that 6 in 10 customers say holiday costs shape their shopping mood and 70% say lower prices would make holiday shopping easier. 2 Walmart’s Holiday Meal Basket helps provide a solution. For $35, customers can serve a complete holiday meal for 10 people — a price of $3.50 per person. The basket includes a mix of 26 trusted national and Walmart brand favorites to prepare beloved dishes, from turkey and stuffing to green bean casserole, sweet potato casserole and pumpkin pie. Not only does this year’s basket have 18% more items, but it also costs 12% less than those same items did last year, making this the lowest priced one-click basket in the program’s history.
 "The Holiday Meal Basket has become one of our favorite traditions at Walmart. It brings our purpose to life in such a meaningful way by helping families make the holidays special without stretching their budgets," said David Guggina, president and CEO, Walmart U.S. "This year, our Holiday Meal Basket brings even more food to the table for just $35, while making it easier for customers to plan, shop, and celebrate in ways that work for them.”

 More Food, More Savings, More to Celebrate 
 Walmart’s Holiday Meal Basket has helped millions of customers enjoy holiday favorites at an affordable price, saving customers more than $350 million since 2022.
 This year's basket goes even further, offering the best value in the program's history with 17 unique products and 26 total items. The expanded basket items reflect changing customer preferences and more side dishes with the addition of sweet potatoes, mini marshmallows, corn muffin mix and more.
 The basket includes the items customers need to prepare many of the season's most-loved dishes:
 The centerpiece: Butterball turkey, priced at just 97 cents per pound - the same price as last year.
 Classic sides: Stove Top stuffing, cranberry sauce, mashed potatoes and gravy, green bean casserole made with trusted brands like Campbell’s Cream of Mushroom Soup, and warm dinner rolls.
 More holiday favorites: Sweet potato casserole with Jet Puffed mini marshmallows and corn casserole made with “JIFFY” corn muffin mix.
 A sweet finish: Pumpkin pie with whipped topping.

 Holiday Meals Made Simple 
 Beyond the items in the basket, Walmart is alleviating stress by making it easier than ever to plan, shop, and get Holiday items to the table.
 The Holiday Meal Basket is available in stores or purchase the entire assortment online with just one click at Walmart.com/HolidaySavingsBasket . Customers will also be able to ask Sparky, Walmart’s AI shopping agent , to add the basket to their online cart. Walmart offers convenient options including curbside pickup, new Express Pickup , and a range of delivery speeds — from one hour or less to scheduled delivery — to fit every family’s holiday needs. 3 
 Walmart is also offering free Express Delivery on the meal basket through November 30, 2026. 4 Whether buying the whole assortment in this year’s Holiday Meal Basket or individual items, there are no purchase quantity limitations. 5 
 Walmart is bringing even more holiday inspiration together in one place. At Walmart.com/HolidayFood , customers can discover the meal basket alongside recipes created specifically around its ingredients, meal inspiration and ideas to make the most of their holiday gatherings. Walmart's Recipe Hub also makes it easy to find recipes for everything from classic sides to dietary preferences and creative ways to use leftovers, with the ability to shop ingredients directly.
 Walmart's Holiday Meal Basket is available now through December 24, 2026 , in stores and online at Walmart.com/HolidaySavingsBasket .

 What is Walmart’s Thanksgiving Meal Basket this year?
 Walmart’s 2026 Thanksgiving Meal Basket delivers a complete holiday spread for 10 people for $35 (that’s $3.50 per person). It bundles 26 items — including a Butterball turkey at $0.97/lb — to make Thanksgiving delicious, abundant, and affordable.
 What is in the meal basket?
 26 national and Walmart brand items:
 "JIFFY" Corn Muffin Mix (2 x 8.5 oz boxes)
 Great Value Golden Sweet Whole Kernel Corn (3 cans x 15 oz)
 Great Value Cut Green Beans, (3 cans x 14.5 oz)
 Campbell's Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup, 10.5 oz Can
 Great Value French Fried Onions Salad Topping, 6 oz (Resealable Bag)
 Fresh Whole Russet Potatoes 5 lb Bag
 Great Value Brown Gravy Mix (2 packets x 0.87 oz)
 Great Value Frozen Traditional Pie Crusts, Two 9-inch Pie Crust & Pans, 15 oz
 Great Value Whipped Topping, Dessert and Fruit Topping, 8 oz (Frozen)
 Great Value 100% Pure Pumpkin, 15 oz
 Great Value Evaporated Milk, 12 fl oz
 Great Value Brown and Serve Rolls 12oz, 12 Count
 Stove Top Stuffing Mix, 1 Box, for Dinner Sides and Thanksgiving Dinner, Turkey, (2 boxes x 6 oz)
 Fresh Cranberries, 12 oz, Bag
 Jet-Puffed Mini Marshmallows, 10 oz Bag
 Fresh Whole Sweet Potatoes, Delicious and Versatile Root Vegetable (3 potatoes)
 Butterball Frozen Whole Turkey, All Natural, 10-16 lbs., Serves 7-11
 How many people does it feed?
 The basket is designed to serve 10 people, with ingredients for generous portions of turkey, stuffing, cranberry sauce, beloved sides like green bean casserole, sweet potato casserole, corn casserole, mashed potatoes, rolls and a pumpkin pie with whipped topping.
 What dishes can I make?
 The basket includes ingredients for generous portions of turkey, stuffing, cranberry sauce, beloved sides like green bean casserole, sweet potato casserole, corn casserole, mashed potatoes, rolls and a pumpkin pie with whipped topping. 
 How much does it cost per person?
 Walmart Meal Basket Serves 10 for $35 –$3.50 per person.
 Are there limits on how many I can purchase?
 No. To purchase the Holiday Meal Basket, there are no special memberships required and no limits on number of purchases per customer. 5 
 Does it require a coupon or membership?
 No. To purchase the Holiday Meal Basket, there are no special memberships required and no limits on number of purchases per customer. 5 
 Can I get it delivered?
 Yes. The meal basket is available in-store, online, for pickup, and with fast delivery options. 3 This year, customers can visit Walmart.com/HolidayFood  to find the meal basket, recipes built exclusively around the basket, and more inspiration all in one place. 
 Walmart is also offering free Express Delivery on the meal basket. 4 
 Can I get it through the new Express Pickup?
 Yes. Walmart offers convenient options including curbside pickup, new Express Pickup , and a range of delivery speeds — from one hour or less to scheduled delivery — to fit every family’s holiday needs. 3 
 Is it all private brands?
 This year’s basket includes five national brands. Additionally, 96% of the items in the basket are on rollback, including four of the five national brand items. Our largest private brand — and the largest food and consumables consumer packaged goods brand in the U.S. — Great Value has been a trusted staple since its launch in 1993. Today, Great Value products can be found in nine out of 10 U.S. households and save an average family up to 35% per year.
 What’s new in 2026?
 With 26 national and private brand items, this year’s basket contains 18% more items than last year. These include: “JIFFY” corn muffin mix, whipped topping for pumpkin pie, and ingredients for sweet potato casserole (sweet potatoes and Jet Puffed mini marshmallows).
 Do you offer recipes for the basket items?
 Customers can visit our Recipe Hub that contains thousands of searchable recipes, including popular Holiday Meal mains and sides. This year, customers can visit Walmart.com/HolidayFood to find the meal basket, recipes built exclusively around the basket, and more inspiration all in one place.
 How long is it available?
 Walmart's Holiday Meal Basket is available now through December 24, 2026, in stores and online at Walmart.com/HolidaySavingsBasket .
 How can I order the meal basket?
 The Holiday Meal Basket is available in-store, online, for pickup, and with fast delivery options. Customers can order the complete basket in seconds at Walmart.com/HolidaySavingsBasket . The shoppable list enables customers to remove or add more items to customize their carts.

 Walmart Inc. (Nasdaq: WMT) is a people-led, tech-powered omnichannel retailer helping people save money and live better - anytime and anywhere - in stores, online, and through their mobile devices. With fiscal year 2026 revenue of $713 billion, Walmart employs approximately 2.1 million associates worldwide. Walmart continues to be a leader in sustainability, corporate philanthropy, and employment opportunity. Additional information about Walmart can be found by visiting corporate.walmart.com , on Facebook at facebook.com/walmart , on X (formerly known as Twitter) at twitter.com/walmart , and on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/company/walmart .
